scope: All original plot headers and bounded point prefixes; not a full payload or task-preparation validation

red.description: Scaled intensity from scanner 1. For visualizing point cloud with pseudo colors.

green.description: Scaled intensity from scanner 2. For visualizing point cloud with pseudo colors.

blue.description: Scaled intensity from scanner 3. For visualizing point cloud with pseudo colors.

deviation_1.description: Echo deviation from scanner 1. Note that the number of missing echo deviation values is slightly higher than the number of missing intensity, amplitude or reflectance values.

deviation_2.description: Echo deviation from scanner 2. Note that the number of missing echo deviation values is slightly higher than the number of missing intensity, amplitude or reflectance values.

deviation_3.description: Echo deviation from scanner 3. Note that the number of missing echo deviation values is slightly higher than the number of missing intensity, amplitude or reflectance values.

tree_index.description: Manually generated tree instance annotation. All points in a tree instance share the same value, and each tree instance within a plot has a unique index. Points not belonging to any tree instance have tree_index set to 0.

edge.description: Tree instances on the edge of the plot with some parts missing have this value set to 1 for all points. All other points have this value set to 0.

dead.description: Tree instances identified as dead via visual inspection have this value set to 1 for all points. All other points have this value set to 0.

user_data.description: This value indicates which scanner an individual point is originally from. The points have been labeled either 1, 2, or 3 for scanners 1, 2, and 3 respectively.

classification.description: Manually generated semantic annotation. Intended for removing particular types of objects from the data.

limitations: Prefix samples are not representative estimates of whole-plot channel availability.
LAS payload hashes are copied from saved manifests, not recomputed by this audit.
Header descriptions report nearest-neighbor channels within 0.25 m; association accuracy and calibration are not validated.
Source YAML calls RGB scaled intensity; the public description calls it scaled reflectance. The physical quantity remains unresolved.
No preparation, model execution, cross-source calibration or independent accuracy is validated.
